model.name: Slotted wideband planar dipole (867 MHz)
model.description: Printed fat dipole for a UAV with a composite (non-metal) fuselage: two wide arms on a vertical 1.6 mm FR-4 strip, fed by a balanced 50 ohm lumped port across a centre gap, no ground plane (x: flight axis, z: up). Transverse slots cut in from both outer edges of each arm lengthen the edge current path and shorten the antenna; the wide arms keep a wide band so that radome and FR-4 detuning do not matter. Vertically polarised, omnidirectional in azimuth, for the 863-870 MHz SRD / LoRa band: 110 x 40 mm of copper (19 % shorter than without the slots), |S11| about -19 dB at 867 MHz and a -10 dB band of about 0.81-0.97 GHz (18 %). See examples/designs/README.md in the fairbeam repository.
